annotations.title: Remove a product or a digital plan from a named list

description: Removes a product (`product_slug`) or a digital plan (`digital_id`) from one of the signed-in person's lists; send exactly one of the two. `removed: false` when it was not there. Another person's list answers not_found.

digital_id.description: A plan id of compare_digital / compare_mobile rows (e.g. claude-pro).

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

name: remove_from_list
title: Remove a product or a digital plan from a named list
